display.purpose: Page h1 headings with a dashed left rule.

title.purpose: Article titles, card headings, and compact section titles.

label.purpose: Buttons, badges, form labels, table headers, and metadata.

caption.purpose: Uppercase table and metric labels, via the label-caps class.

motion.name: state-colors
motion.purpose: Default transition for hover and focus color changes.

motion.name: view-transition-safe
motion.purpose: Document-level navigation transitions only when the user has not requested reduced motion.

components.name: Button
components.css: .ds-btn { cursor: pointer; display: inline-grid; grid-auto-flow: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; width: max-content; border: 1px dashed var(--line); background: transparent; padding: 4px 12px; color: var(--fg); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.429; transition: color 150ms, background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn:not(:disabled):hover, .ds-btn[aria-pressed=true] { border-color: var(--line-active); background: var(--panel); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Secondary action in dense admin rows; a dashed underline.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { cursor: pointer; width: max-content; border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0; color: var(--fg-muted); font-size: 0.875rem; text-decoration: underline dashed; text-underline-offset: 4px; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-btn-quiet:not(:disabled):hover { color: var(--fg); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-quiet:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Hint Button
components.description: The 1rem square that opens a tooltip.
components.css: .ds-btn-hint { cursor: pointer; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 1rem; height: 1rem; border: 1px dashed var(--line-strong); background: transparent; padding: 0; color: var(--fg-muted); font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-btn-hint:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--line-active); color: var(--fg); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text fields and selects; rendered by Input.astro.
components.css: .ds-input { border: 1px dashed var(--line); background: transparent; padding: 8px 12px; color: var(--fg); font-size: 0.875rem; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--fg-muted); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--line-active); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: State label; color always maps to state.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: max-content; border: 1px dashed var(--line-success); padding: 4px 10px; color: var(--fg-success); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; text-transform: capitalize; }

components.name: Dashed Plane
components.description: The default container: a flat plane with no shadow.
components.css: .ds-plane { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; border: 1px dashed var(--line); padding: 16px; color: var(--fg); } .ds-plane-label { margin: 0; color: var(--fg-muted); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-plane-value { margin: 0; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Section Tabs
components.description: Admin section navigation; the current page takes the ink border.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; justify-content: start; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-tabs a { border: 1px dashed var(--line); padding: 4px 12px; color: var(--fg-muted); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-tabs a[aria-current=page] { border-color: var(--fg); color: var(--fg); } .ds-tabs a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The craftlions interface should feel like a careful technical ledger: plain, exact, and useful under repeated client review. The system is intentionally restrained, with neutral surfaces, dashed linework, compact spacing, and direct labels carrying the experience instead of decorative treatments.

The visual language supports freelance clients who are checking project state, phases, invoices, and budget details. It should make the work easier to trust by making structure obvious: rows, sections, dividers, labels, and controls are drawn with the same light hand across the public site and authenticated portal.

This system explicitly rejects overdesigned SaaS gloss, decorative dashboards, marketing-heavy component patterns, novelty interactions, and visual noise. It is allowed to be quiet; it is not allowed to be vague.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral light and dark surfaces with a small set of semantic state colors.
Dashed borders as the primary structural material.
Grid-based layouts with a wide two-column dashboard; public surfaces stay compact single-column.
System sans typography with clear weights instead of display styling.
Flat components with visible focus, hover, disabled, and loading states.

rules.name: The Line Before Color Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with neutral dashed lines before color is introduced. Color is reserved for links, status, focus, risk, progress, and categorical data in charts.

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: Blue, green, and red must map to information, success, and error/risk. Do not use state colors as decoration. The one exception is the spend chart's categorical hatch marks, which use the chart palette and encode data, not state (see Data Visualization).

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Product UI stays in one system sans family. Do not introduce display fonts for labels, buttons, tables, or data.

rules.name: The Exact Numbers Rule
rules.body: Amounts, percentages, and invoice data use tabular numerals when they need comparison.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are forbidden for normal cards, tables, buttons, and inputs. If a future overlay truly needs elevation, keep it structural and minimal, never glossy.

rules.name: The Dashed Plane Rule
rules.body: A container is a plane drawn with a 1px dashed neutral border and transparent background. Do not pair this with soft drop shadows.

dos: Do use inline Tailwind utilities built on role tokens, and grid layouts, to match the existing project conventions.
Do use 1px dashed neutral borders for structure, panels, tables, inputs, empty states, and buttons.
Do keep product data exact, scannable, and close to its label.
Do use neutral hover fills and visible focus outlines on interactive controls.
Do preserve reduced-motion behavior; view transitions are only enabled for users without reduced-motion preference.
Do keep semantic color rare and tied to state: blue for info/link, green for success, red for error/risk; only the spend chart adds muted ink hatch marks for data (see Data Visualization).
donts: Don't use marketing-heavy component patterns in the client portal.
Don't add novelty interactions or decorative motion.
Don't add visual noise that makes routine client review feel more complex than it is.
Don't make the product feel like a generic startup template or a showpiece at the expense of clarity.
Don't pair dashed borders with soft shadows, glassmorphism, gradient text, rounded card stacks, or decorative illustrations.
